title: A flaw was found in the SAML 1.1 XML parsing logic of Keycloak, an open-source identity and access… (CVE-2026-107602)
description: A vulnerability in Keycloak's SAML 1.1 XML parsing logic causes an infinite loop when unexpected elements appear in a security token's key information section. This flaw allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to trigger 100% CPU usage, resulting in a denial of service that requires a server restart to recover.
